overall.verdict: Two Sagittarius partners fly as two arrows from one bow — honest, restless, generous, both ruled by expansive Jupiter. The recognition is instant and the freedom mutual; the work is giving commitments deliberate landing spots, since neither arrow aims naturally at the ground.

categories.love: Romance between two Sagittarius partners is bright and unforced: spontaneous trips, laughing debates, compliments delivered bluntly and gratefully received. Both love out loud and neither nests by default, so devotion needs deliberate rituals. A shared adventure calendar keeps the fire burning with direction.
categories.sexual: Chemistry is playful and spirited — fire doubled, with humour woven through desire and neither sign shy about naming what delights them. Novelty matters to both, and spontaneity keeps the spark bright. Slowing down occasionally, rather than sprinting, lets the warmth land more deeply.
categories.friendship: As friends, two Sagittarius partners are each other's ideal expedition companion: both say yes quickly, laugh loudly and forgive fast. The hazard is flakiness — each may drift to a better horizon and cancel. A standing ritual neither may reschedule keeps the friendship solid.
categories.communication: Talk is candid, fast and funny — two blunt speakers rarely take offence, though occasionally both do at once. Debates roam gloriously and decisions drift with them. Agreeing that every discussion ends with one decision, however small, turns wonderful conversation into working conversation.
categories.trust: Goodwill between two Sagittarius partners is abundant and immediate; the gap is follow-through, since both overbook, both forget, and both assume the other understands. Faith grows through kept promises rather than spoken vows. Making commitments few, specific and dated is what builds belief.
categories.emotional: Emotionally, both partners process by reframing — laugh, learn, look forward — and heavy feelings can get skipped entirely. The bond deepens when either sits with an un-funny feeling once before moving on. Sharing one honest low moment each week builds real depth.

tips: Name a landing spot for every big plan — arrows need targets and dates.
Attach one kind sentence to blunt truths; fire scalds when it rushes.
Trade the navigator's seat weekly so neither partner plans every journey.
Keep one standing ritual neither may cancel — a fixed table, a monthly trek.
When feelings turn heavy, sit through them once before reframing.
Overbooked? Renegotiate openly instead of drifting towards a newer horizon.

overall.verdict: Sagittarius and Capricorn are neighbours with different maps — roaming, optimistic fire beside climbing, deliberate earth. Classically, Jupiter, Sagittarius' ruler, is said to sit in fall in Capricorn, an old image of luck learning patience; kind criticism and shared summits keep this demanding bond steady.

categories.love: Affection is real and differently aimed: Sagittarius loves through shared adventure and generous humour, Capricorn through reliability, provision and long-horizon care. Sagittarius may find Capricorn's caution heavy; Capricorn may find Sagittarius' spontaneity unsettling. Naming each other's dialect of devotion, out loud, keeps warmth supplied.
categories.sexual: Chemistry warms gradually: Sagittarius brings play and boldness, Capricorn patience and a quiet depth that emerges with trust. Sagittarius should slow the tempo; Capricorn should risk lightness. Unhurried time and freedom from judgement let this neighbourly spark settle into genuine warmth.
categories.friendship: As friends, Sagittarius books by mood and Capricorn by calendar, and the mismatch is effortful rather than hostile. The archer widens the goat's world; the goat makes the archer's plans real. Explicit plans, honestly renewed, let both styles contribute without friction hardening.
categories.communication: Talk is the semi-sextile's friction zone: Sagittarius improvises and exaggerates for effect, while Capricorn corrects and qualifies. Sagittarius hears a lecture; Capricorn hears recklessness. Agreeing that ideas get heard before advice begins, and coaching rather than auditing, turns the loop into genuine teamwork.
categories.trust: Faith takes deliberate construction: Sagittarius' flexible promises unsettle Capricorn's careful ledger, while Capricorn's corrections can feel like judgement to free-spirited Sagittarius. Freedom with a set time of return, and small promises kept visibly, build belief steadily in both directions.
categories.emotional: Emotionally, Sagittarius works through moods quickly and Capricorn stores them in private reserve, releasing them rarely. Sagittarius may read the reserve as coldness; Capricorn may read the quick recovery as missing depth. A short, honest weekly debrief gives both styles room to be heard.

tips: Ask whether ideas or advice are wanted before responding; both mean to help.
Capricorn: coach once, gently; Sagittarius: land one promise and keep it visibly.
Put adventures on the calendar; spontaneity survives better with a set date.
Trade roles monthly — the archer picks the route, the goat manages the map.
After a lecture lands badly, lead with humour and try again tomorrow.
Celebrate small wins loudly; encouragement moves this pair faster than correction.

overall.verdict: Sagittarius and Aquarius are fellow explorers — roaming fire and fixed air feeding each other's ideas, causes and love of open space. The sextile makes the adventure easy; the watch-item is drift, since two free orbits can wander apart without a scheduled return.

categories.love: Romance grows out of genuine friendship: Sagittarius brings warmth, spontaneity and bold optimism, Aquarius originality, acceptance and respect for freedom. Devotion shows as shared missions and mutual cheering. Naming affection explicitly matters, since both signs can mistake comfortable ease for the absence of romance.
categories.sexual: Chemistry is lively and experimental — fire's enthusiasm meeting air's curiosity, each delighted by the other's openness. Novelty keeps the spark fresh, and honest conversation about wants keeps both engaged. Rushing past affection into adventure alone is the one misstep that cools this pairing.
categories.friendship: As friends, this is the classic adventurers' duo: Aquarius networks, organises causes and invents; Sagittarius roams, philosophises and rallies. Both grant the other space gladly, so the bond survives long gaps. Deliberate contact — a scheduled trek or call — turns survival into thriving.
categories.communication: Conversation is easy, funny and idea-rich: Sagittarius philosophises, Aquarius innovates, and neither is easily offended. The snag is altitude — everything stays conceptual while feelings go unnamed and decisions float. Naming one feeling and one decision per big talk keeps ideas connected to life.
categories.trust: Both signs honour independence, which makes faith easy and maintenance easy to forget. Each assumes the other's orbit is stable, and benign neglect quietly accumulates. Aquarius' fixed routines and Sagittarius' mutable schedule both benefit from visible agreements and shown-up moments, kept consistently.
categories.emotional: Emotionally, both partners keep feelings light-footed: Sagittarius reframes towards optimism, Aquarius analyses towards understanding, and neither lingers long. Heavy moods can get skipped rather than shared. One unhurried, agenda-free conversation each week gives both signs practice at staying with feeling.

tips: Check in on a rhythm, not a whim; free orbits need scheduled flybys.
Debate openly, then close each debate with a decision someone owns.
Sagittarius: send the itinerary; Aquarius: send the counter-proposal — plan together.
Share one cause or project; purpose is this pair's strongest glue.
Let distance mean adventure, not absence — and say so explicitly.
Keep one weekly ritual neither may skip; drift is the only real threat here.

overall.verdict: Sagittarius and Pisces square off as blunt fire against dreamy water, and the different instincts run deep: arrows versus tides. An older tradition gives both signs to Jupiter, though modern reading adds Neptune to Pisces; with patience and gentleness, compassion becomes common ground.

categories.love: Attraction runs on contrast: Sagittarius' bright honesty fascinates Pisces, and Pisces' tenderness softens the archer's edge. The strain shows in expression — candour stings, hints go unheard. With patience, each can learn the other's dialect; saying affection plainly and delivering truth warmly is the path.
categories.sexual: Chemistry is live but pace-sensitive: Sagittarius brings playful spark, Pisces brings depth and mood, and each offers the other unfamiliar weather. Pisces needs reassurance before opening; Sagittarius needs to slow by half. With practice, unhurried pacing and gentle words let desire settle comfortably.
categories.friendship: As friends, Sagittarius rallies groups and plans expeditions while Pisces prefers quiet, imaginative company, and both mutable signs shift plans readily. Keeping plans few, simple and confirmed once — kindly — suits this pairing. The archer's encouragement and the fish's empathy are worth the effort.
categories.communication: Talk is this square's steepest slope: Sagittarius states truths at full volume, while Pisces communicates in hints, moods and silence. Arrows sting; hints vanish. One kind sentence before every honesty, and questions asked in plain words, slowly turn misfired messages into understanding.
categories.trust: Faith is the square's hardest ground: Sagittarius' loose timing can read to Pisces as carelessness, while Pisces' vagueness can read to Sagittarius as hiding. With practice, small kept promises and gentle honesty rebuild belief steadily. Slowly, predictability becomes this pair's quiet reassurance.
categories.emotional: Pisces feels in deep tides and absorbs the room; Sagittarius reframes quickly and moves towards the horizon. Each misreads the other's tempo — speed as indifference, depth as drama. Slowly, making room for both rhythms, without judging either, builds genuine emotional safety.

tips: Attach one kind sentence to every truth; arrows land softer with feathers.
Pisces: ask for what is needed plainly; Sagittarius: slow the pace by half.
Keep plans small and confirm them once, gently, the day before.
After a sting, comfort first and explanation later; keep that order.
Take a weekly walk together; movement helps fire speak and water settle.
Let each keep one solo pursuit; time apart makes reunion kinder.
